This fixes the issue reported in this comment: https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14851#issuecomment-3863896385

```py

    print("SYNC START", flush=True)
```

The bug was caused by `APIRouter.__init__` assigning `self.on_startup` and `self.on_shutdown` before calling `super().__init__()`. Since `APIRouter` inherits from `starlette.routing.Router`, the parent's initialization method was overwriting these attributes, causing any startup and shutdown event handlers passed to `APIRouter` (and by extension `FastAPI` when using routers) to be ignored.
